faqs.question: What is an AI Visibility Review?

children.text: It’s an assessment of how AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity find, describe and recommend your business, plus a plan to improve it.

faqs.question: How is this different from SEO?

children.text: SEO helps you rank in search results. AI visibility is about whether AI tools understand your business well enough to mention and recommend it in their answers. The two overlap, and we cover both where they meet.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee we’ll show up in ChatGPT?

children.text: No, and anyone who promises that is guessing. We make sure you follow every known best practice so you’re set up to succeed.

faqs.question: Which AI tools do you review?

children.text: ChatGPT, Google Gemini and AI Overviews, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

faqs.question: What are OpenAI’s Business Hub and Business Agents?

children.text: A central place for businesses to manage their presence and information on ChatGPT, monitor engagement and manage their business profile.
AI-powered assistants that help businesses interact with potential customers, answer questions and support customer enquiries directly through ChatGPT.
We’ll review whether your business is eligible and help you get set up correctly.

faqs.question: Do we need a new website?

children.text: Usually not. Most improvements are content, structure and listing updates to the site you already have.
Yes. Every package builds on the one before, and you can add execution hours or quarterly re-checks at any time.
AI tools change quickly. We recommend a check every quarter to keep track of how you’re showing up.
